spindle.environment.CapabilityKey.title: CapabilityKey
spindle.environment.CapabilityKey.description: A capability name, which provides exactly that capability, or a prefix ending in `.*`, which provides every capability under that prefix (README.md § Environment, the documentation of `Environment` in crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs).

spindle.environment.Provision.title: Provision
spindle.environment.Provision.description: One key of the environment document's `provides` and its implementations, in order of preference (README.md § Environment, `Environment::provides` in crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs).

capability.description: The capability, or the `prefix.*` key, these implementations provide (`Environment::provides` in crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs).

implementations.description: The implementations that provide it, each named by its identifier, most preferred first (README.md § Environment, `Environment::provides` in crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs).
